burn(uint256).details: Called when a loan is repaid or liquidated. For StandardPositionAdapter,      this is a no-op. For NFT adapters, this burns the ERC721.

params.loanId: The loan ID whose position should be burned

initialize(address,address).details: Called once by the factory immediately after deploying the      minimal proxy. Must use OpenZeppelin's Initializable to guard      against re-initialization.

params.complianceAdapter: Address of the ComplianceAdapter, or address(0)
params.factory: Address of the MarketFactory that deployed this clone

mint(address,uint256).details: Called during loan origination. For StandardPositionAdapter,      this is a no-op. For NFT adapters, this mints an ERC721.

params.loanId: The loan ID this position represents
params.to: Address to mint the position token to (the borrower)

ownerOf(uint256).details: For StandardPositionAdapter, this returns the original borrower      (positions cannot change hands). For TransferablePositionAdapter,      this returns the current NFT holder (may differ from original borrower).

returns._0: owner Current address that owns this position

burn(uint256).notice: Burn a position token (on repay or liquidation)

initialize(address,address).notice: Initialize a cloned position adapter instance

mint(address,uint256).notice: Mint a position token for a new loan

ownerOf(uint256).notice: Get the current owner of a position
